title: Store and Recall
description: Learn to use SET and GET by storing a name and reading it back.

steps.hint: Type SET player_name "Alex" and press Enter.
steps.explanation: SET stores a value under a key. Think of it as labeling a box.

steps.hint: Type GET player_name to see what you stored.
steps.explanation: GET opens the labeled box and shows what is inside.

title: Count Up and Down
description: Learn to use INCR and DECR to change a number.

steps.hint: Type SET score 0 to start at zero.
steps.explanation: SET can store a number too. Strings can hold any text.

steps.hint: Type INCR score to go from 0 to 1.
steps.explanation: INCR adds one to a number value.

steps.hint: Type DECR score to go back down.
steps.explanation: DECR removes one. Numbers go down the same way they go up.

title: Time Limits
description: Learn to set a timer on a key with EXPIRE and check it with TTL.

steps.objective: Light a torch: SET torch lit
steps.hint: Type SET torch lit to create a key called torch.
steps.explanation: You made a key called torch with the value lit.

steps.objective: Give it a timer: EXPIRE torch 60
steps.hint: Type EXPIRE torch 60 to start a 60-second timer.
steps.explanation: EXPIRE sets a countdown. When it hits zero, the key goes away.

steps.hint: Type TTL torch to see how many seconds remain.
steps.explanation: TTL shows the seconds left. It counts down in real time.

title: Delete and Check
description: Learn to remove a key with DEL and check with EXISTS.

steps.objective: Store a value: SET temp hello
steps.explanation: You stored a value. Now let us erase it.

steps.objective: Check if it exists: EXISTS temp
steps.explanation: EXISTS returns 1 if the key is there, 0 if it is not.
DEL removes a key for good. Gone forever.

title: Profiles and Fields
description: Learn HSET and HGET by building a hero profile.

steps.objective: Build a hero: HSET hero:1 name Alex hp 100
steps.hint: Type HSET hero:1 name Alex hp 100.
steps.explanation: HSET stores fields under one key.

steps.objective: Read a field: HGET hero:1 hp
steps.explanation: HGET reads one field from the hash.
HGETALL shows every field and value at once.

title: Queues and Lines
description: Learn LPUSH and LRANGE by building a queue.

steps.objective: Push an enemy: LPUSH enemies Goblin
steps.explanation: LPUSH adds to the left end of a list.

steps.objective: Push from the other side: RPUSH enemies Dragon
steps.explanation: RPUSH adds to the right end. Two sides, one list.

steps.hint: Type LRANGE enemies 0 -1 to see all items.
steps.explanation: LRANGE shows items in order. 0 to -1 means all.

title: Unique Collections
description: Learn SADD and SMEMBERS by building a party.

steps.objective: Add party members: SADD party Mage Warrior
steps.explanation: SADD adds unique members to a set. No duplicates.
SMEMBERS shows everything in the set.

title: Ranked Scores
description: Learn ZADD and ZRANGE by building a leaderboard.

steps.objective: Add a score: ZADD scores 100 Alex
steps.explanation: ZADD adds a member with a score. The score decides rank.
ZRANGE shows members from lowest to highest score.
